about: The recorded tapes of core-arch task 0.3 (owner decisions Q123, Q130), read by test/tape/real/real-tapes.ts. Each tape is a JSON-lines tape (TT-1) holding every IN-8 call of every height of its range and a live window of both head subscriptions, recorded once with tools/tape/main.ts range through the recording builder. The tapes are not in this repository: they are kept on the machine that recorded them until the owner decides where they are stored; a test finds a tape in the directory named by UMBRADB_TAPES under its file name, checks its size and SHA-256, and is skipped with the tape's name as the reason when it is absent.

tapes.name: mainnet-1774000-1780000
tapes.bounds: From 491 blocks before mainnet's 1.0 upgrade to 1,780,000, the end A99 names: U 1,774,491 (0x40e3…dd23, MNSV 22_000; its block carries the runtime, 1.1 MB) and F 1,774,492 (0x3802…1a0b, MNSV 1_000_000), the LG-2 pin; 91 blocks with Midnight transactions on both sides (ContractCall 86, ContractDeploy 2, unshielded transfers 3), one failed extrinsic (1,774,005, a FederatedAuthority governance call, not a Midnight transaction) and 31 system transactions. It starts mid-chain: decoding, events, outcomes and the pin need nothing else, but A99's state roots need the ledger state at 1,774,000 (A99's "from a backup taken before block 1,774,492").

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.mainnet.midnight.network --from 1774000 --to 1780000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: decoding, events and outcomes across the 0.22 to 1.0 upgrade (A89, A91 on mainnet), the 1,774,492 pin (A94)
notes.needs: the ledger state at 1,774,000 for state roots (A99 mainnet half: a backup made by a sync from genesis, tasks 15.1, 18.x)

tapes.name: mainnet-1780000-1790000
tapes.bounds: Contiguous with mainnet-1774000-1780000 (its first block is that tape's last, so a process restarted at cursor 1,780,000 continues on this tape) through LG-8's scenario block 1,788,980 (0x627e…0cf5, a block with a Midnight contract call) and 1,020 blocks beyond it, all of runtime 1_000_000; 278 blocks carry Midnight transactions (281 contract calls, 1 maintenance) and 508 the node's own system transactions. One backup at 1,774,000 serves both mainnet tapes in turn. It starts mid-chain: decoding, events and outcomes need nothing else, but A99's state roots need the ledger state at 1,780,000.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.mainnet.midnight.network --from 1780000 --to 1790000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: decoding, events and outcomes of runtime 1.0 blocks with many transactions; LG-8 scenario block 1,788,980 for decoding
notes.needs: the ledger state at 1,780,000 for state roots (A99: the state after replaying mainnet-1774000-1780000 from a backup at 1,774,000)

tapes.name: preprod-0-10000
tapes.bounds: Preprod from genesis: block 0 (genesis_state, and cNight registrations under Mappings) and the first 10,000 blocks, built by runtime 22_000 (0.22, ledger v8) throughout. From genesis, so it serves state roots on its own; only 3 blocks carry Midnight transactions (1,207, 1,458, 1,716): preprod's first blocks are nearly empty.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.preprod.midnight.network --from 0 --to 10000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: every criterion that replays from genesis, runtime 0.22 (LG-8 rule of 0.22), few transactions

tapes.name: preview-0-10000
tapes.bounds: Preview from genesis: block 0 (its genesis_state and cNight registrations, IN-7) and the first 10,000 blocks, all built by runtime 1_000_000 (ledger v8). A replay from genesis has every state it needs, so the tape serves A99 (state roots against the node) on its own, as well as decoding, events and outcomes; 209 of its blocks carry Midnight transactions (deploys, calls, maintenance, unshielded transfers) and 44 the node's own system transactions.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.preview.midnight.network --from 0 --to 10000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: every criterion that replays from genesis: decoding, events, outcomes, and state roots (A99 preview from genesis, A91 events)

tapes.name: preview-1073620-1075620
tapes.bounds: 1,000 blocks each side of preview's runtime 1.0.300 upgrade (U 1,074,620 enacts it, F 1,074,621 is the first block of spec_version 1_000_300; found by bisecting state_getRuntimeVersion): LG-8's replay rule changes there, and the range holds 8 blocks with Midnight transactions before U and 12 after F, 3 of them partial successes. It starts mid-chain: decoding, events and outcomes need nothing else, but a replay of its state roots (A99's preview half) needs the ledger state at 1,073,620, from an UmbraDB backup of a sync from genesis.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.preview.midnight.network --from 1073620 --to 1075620 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: decoding, events and outcomes across the 1.0.300 upgrade (U decoded with the old metadata, F with the new; LG-4, A89)
notes.needs: the ledger state at 1,073,620 for state roots (A99)
